scenes.spoken_narration: Fulham's defence is under siege, with the manager vowing to block any Red Devils temptation before the season's crucial run‑in.

on_screen.headline: Fulham defence under siege
on_screen.subheadline: Silva vows to block United lure

scenes.spoken_narration: And — Calvin Bassey is at the heart of the tug‑of‑war, as United circle the young centre‑back.

on_screen.headline: Calvin Bassey at centre of tug‑of‑war

scenes.spoken_narration: Now — United have not put a figure on the table, whereas Fulham are reportedly preparing a new deal with a £30 million release clause, but no agreement has been reached.

on_screen.headline: Fresh contract talks with £30m release clause

scenes.spoken_narration: Meanwhile — Silva has warned any distraction could derail their European push, and Bassey's agent says the defender wants security before any move.
So — will Fulham lock Bassey down and keep the Red Devils at bay, or will United finally pry him away and reshape the title race?

on_screen.headline: Lock him down or let United pry him away?

scenes.spoken_narration: Either way — this is football in thirty seconds. Follow for daily transfer updates.
